text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The distinguished autumn Tenno Sho has arrived, and Biwa Hayahide examines my face closely while we're in the prep room.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since she's a worrier at heart, she can't help but check to see if I've been keeping my promise to get more sleep.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satisfied that I am, she heads to the race, ready to prove the effectiveness of the winning equation we've built together.
